reviews.title: Such a beautiful and powerful board!
reviews.comment: I love this mother board. The extra features are nice to have but not necessary. I do have my CPU (9800x3d) over locked as much as I can. So if you aren’t over clocking and just running your cpu out of the box this board is a waste of money go with a lower priced board. The only thing I was was different was this was a back connect board. There is a white gigabyte board but it’s not X870e only x870.
reviews.author: Rawdilz

reviews.title: Gigabyte does it again!
reviews.comment: I've been very impressed with Gigabyte so far.  This is a decent motherboard and goes perfect with my white build.  One con for me though is it doesn't have a reset CMOS button which is critical for trying to overclock.  The CMOS battery and reset jumper pins are in the bottom right of the board under a heatsink.  If you have a water cooled GPU with the radiator mounted inside, it's virtually impossible to get your hand in there to clear the CMOS/reset BIOS. I probably should have paid closer attention to this missing feature.  Otherwise, great board and lots of options to overclock.

reviews.title: Great motherboard
reviews.comment: Great motherboard. Have had it installed for about 5 months now and with no issues. I had to update the BIOS when I installed so be aware of that if you are thinking about purchasing it.
